name: Faithful Fighting (Combat)
body:
When you wield the weapon of your god, you fight with worthy effectiveness.

Requirements: Weapon Focus with your deity’s favored weapon, cleric 8 or legendary inquisitor 8.

Benefit: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls when attacking with your deity’s favored weapon. This stacks with the bonus granted by Weapon Focus. In addition, your cleric and/or legendary inquisitor levels are treated as fighter levels for the purpose of qualifying for feats.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
